description: This file provides a wrapper around system setjmp and compiler-specific try/catch mechanisms for signal handling and evaluation. It declares a platform-specific function for handling SIGBUS signals on non-MSVC compilers and a more general function for evaluating a callback with source and destination buffers.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_sigbus
methods.description: Handles SIGBUS signals, platform-specific for non-MSVC compilers.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_eval3
methods.description: Evaluates a callback function with source and destination buffers, returning an offset.
